annotations.title: Read the X Chat privacy settings

description: The connected X account's X Chat (direct message) PRIVACY SETTINGS: who can message the brand (allowDmsFrom: all / verified / following), whether subscribers can always message it, the low-quality request filter, read receipts, and audio/video call permissions. Use it before changing them with update_x_chat_settings, or to answer 'can customers DM us on X'. Read-only. Needs X connected with direct-message access: an X connection made before 2026-08-25 must be reconnected once under Connectors > X (the tool says so without calling X). Costs credits (X bills per call).

account.description: which connected account: its @handle or id from list_connector_accounts; needed only when several are connected
